final: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS mean_station_average, AVG(station_avg - overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM station_averages CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE station_avg > overall_avg
